title: Refresh mcp-server README tool statements
description:
mcp-server/README.md hardcodes a stale generated-tool count in four places; the generator currently emits substantially more tools than stated.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The README carries no hardcoded tool count that can silently rot; it states the generation mechanism instead
- [hard] REQ-02: Statements about tool generation match the current generator behavior
